page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.16xlarge is an x86_64 server instance within the High Clock Speed family, powered by the KVM hypervisor. Compute capacity is delivered through 64 dedicated vCPUs based on Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a 3.1 GHz base clock speed. The dedicated vCPU assignment ensures consistent thread scheduling without shared-core interference, providing reliable execution for CPU-intensive tasks.

System memory is scaled to 512.0 GB, yielding a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio of 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU. This allocation places the instance firmly in memory-intensive territory while maintaining elevated processor clock speeds. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, necessitating external cloud block storage for operating system and application data persistence. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero GPUs bundled into the instance profile. External connectivity is driven by a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation, though no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

The combination of 3.1 GHz clock frequencies and 512 GB of system memory makes this configuration suited for in-memory relational databases, distributed caching clusters such as Redis or Memcached, and large data processing pipelines. Tradeoffs include the complete absence of local non-volatile storage, making transactional disk performance dependent on cloud storage provisioning and the 20 Gbps network pipe.
